      Ventana de reseñas: 9 sept 2026 - 9 sept 2026

## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      4 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 10 jul 2026 - 10 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _AJey Calloway_, 18 jul 2026, 1/5: "I'm completely over this app. I joined planet fitness 2 weeks ago and still have not been able to get this app to work. I tried logging in half a dozen times and it freezes. I've only been able to successfully login 1 time and even then it never gave to QR code so that I can scan everytime I enter planet fitness. I'm sooo over this and it's just frustrating. Even the team members that work there couldn't figure out why this is happening."
            2. _Zachary Bohannon_, 13 jul 2026, 1/5: "awful designed app i literally cannot log in to the app it's so broken"
            3. _Emily Foster_, 10 jul 2026, 1/5: "horrible service requires close to 100 bucks just to cancel any membership and workers are rude. Even after you pay the membership they take another payment for what the "last month" would be even if you don't go anymore. there cleaner and nicer places to go for free with kind workers than this place app can also lag a lot and not work for up to 20-25 min never again"
<!--/ir-theme-->
